latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: fast cloud-based AI video editing for raw footage.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB), describe edits, and get 1080p MP4 output in 30-60 seconds.
- Automatic setup: handles token generation, session creation, and backend connection.
- Supports rapid trimming, transitions, aspect ratio changes, audio tracks, and text overlays via natural language prompts.
- User-friendly error handling for file types, size, credits, and rate limits.
- Detailed session and job handling to ensure smooth cloud processing and export.
- Designed for content creators and marketers needing fast, hands-off video editing.
